rows.label: Cryotic
rows.note: pays the same on any node, so Earth or Venus is as good as Pluto

conditions: Excavation Void Fissures are not always up; don't wait on one for 800.
bonuses: A Resource Booster, Resourceful or Loyal Retriever, or a Smeeta Kavat's Charm double it.
Duviri Circuit pays a small amount too; you may already hold enough.

groups.activity: Survival on Ani or Mot, or Capture on Hepit or Ukko
conditions: Argon decays 24 hours after pickup. Have the Salvage, Oxium and Cryotic ready first, and don't start the 24-hour build without it.
bonuses: A max-range Xaku (Vast Untime) or Limbo (Cataclysm) on Hepit or Ukko breaks every container, and each broken Pegmatite shows a waypoint to the crystals; public Hepit lobbies often have one.
Nekros plus Khora (Pilfering Strangledome) is the wiki's Survival setup.
Its own Mastery, separate from Kuva Tonkor.
